subject.title: feat: add Hermes Agent connector example

question: Should ClickClack maintain a production-shaped Hermes-specific connector in this repository, or should Hermes integration remain an external package built on generic bot APIs?
rationale: The branch introduces a substantial third-party integration plus new server and SDK contracts, and repository intent cannot be inferred safely from the existing generic bot example alone.

options.title: Narrow and keep in core
options.body: Retain the example after fixing authorization and durable recovery, while limiting core API additions to reusable bot capabilities.

options.title: Move connector externally
options.body: Keep reusable API and SDK changes here but publish the Hermes-specific runtime as a separately maintained integration.

options.title: Pause the integration
options.body: Close or defer the connector until maintainers explicitly sponsor Hermes as a repository-owned example surface.

recommendation.title: Narrow and keep in core
recommendation.body: Retain the example after fixing authorization and durable recovery, while limiting core API additions to reusable bot capabilities.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice concerns repository-level product scope and the long-term ownership of bot integration examples.
